query:
UPDATE menu_sections
                        SET name        = COALESCE($1, name),
                            description = COALESCE($2, description),
                            position    = COALESCE($3, position),
                            is_active   = COALESCE($4, is_active),
                            parent_id   = COALESCE($5, parent_id),
                            updated_at  = NOW(),
                            updated_by  = $7
                        WHERE id = $6
                        RETURNING id
